chunks: O People of the Book, why do you dispute about Abraham, while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Do you not use your intellect?
ai.seo_question: Why do Jews and Christians dispute about Abraham according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate that Abraham (Ibrahim) was a Hanif, adhering to pure monotheism prior to the specific legal codes of Judaism and Christianity. The chronological argument highlights that attributing later revealed scriptures to him is an anachronism, reinforcing the concept of Fitrah (innate monotheism) over sectarian legalism. This context underscores the Shia view of the Ahl al-Bayt's lineage as the continuation of Abraham's pure tradition, distinct from later scriptural accretions.
